description: Shared environmental signals: platform-owned DEFINITIONS only. Which Brain consumes a signal is declared by that Brain in brains/<dir>/brain.json (consumes[].kind = signal). Every entry below is DECLARED: no producer publishes it yet, so any declared consumption evaluates UNAVAILABLE (never FRESH, never zero). Registering a producer is a reviewed change to this file.

signals.description: Surface atmospheric pressure at or near the waterbody.
Change of barometric pressure over a defined window (rising / falling / steady with rate).
Liquid-equivalent precipitation over a defined window.
Near-surface air temperature at or near the waterbody.
Fraction of sky covered by cloud, with sky-condition category where available.
Lunar illumination fraction and phase name for the local night.
